\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{രുചിയുള്ള}}
\textbf{\ml{രുചിയുള്ള}} — \emph{ruciyuḷḷa} — \textquotedblleft{}tasty\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{രുചിയുള്ള}} (\emph{ruciyuḷḷa}) joins Sanskrit \emph{ruci}, \textquotedblleft{}light, beauty\textquotedblright{}, later \textquotedblleft{}relish, taste\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 10762), to native \emph{-uḷḷa}, \textquotedblleft{}that has\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 697).
\end{cousinweb}
